mapper.select: select star_list.star, count(satisfaction) as ent_num, count(satisfaction) * 100 / ( select count(*) as num from sc_contract_evaluate where satisfaction > 0 ) as rate from (select 1 as star union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5) star_list left join sc_contract_evaluate sce on sce.satisfaction = star_list.star group by star_list.star

select ( 1 * count(if(satisfaction = 1, 1, null)) + 2 * count(if(satisfaction = 2, 1, null)) + 3 * count(if(satisfaction = 3, 1, null)) + 4 * count(if(satisfaction = 4, 1, null)) + 5 * count(if(satisfaction = 5, 1, null)) ) / count(if(satisfaction > 0, 1, null)) as average from sc_contract_evaluate
